title: Computer control
allow: Let the assistant control this computer
allow_detail: Sees the screen, clicks, types, and takes screenshots through Cua Driver
offline: The machine is offline. It can be controlled once it's back
install_detail: Downloads the installer from the Cua website, verifies it, installs it in Applications, and turns off its usage stats.
install_confirm: Downloads the installer from the Cua website on this Mac, verifies it, installs it in Applications, and turns off its usage stats. Once installed it asks for Accessibility and Screen Recording access; click Allow on that Mac's screen.
allow_detail_lcu: Sees the screen, clicks, and types through LCU. Confirmations are on the phone and web
install_detail_lcu: Downloads the LCU release from GitHub and verifies it. Does not register Claude / Codex approval UIs, and does not install ChatGPT; install the official ChatGPT desktop app yourself first.
install_confirm_lcu: Downloads the LCU release from GitHub on this Mac, verifies it, and installs it. Does not register Claude or Codex; confirmations stay on the phone and web. Requires the official ChatGPT desktop app already installed; Persona will not download or sign into it. The first time, allow ChatGPT Accessibility and Screen Recording on that Mac.
allow_from_here: To click Allow from here, use View screen at the top of this page.
